data.name: RE:MEMBER
data.detailed_description:
SILENCE IS BLINDNESS. SOUND IS DEATH.

You open your eyes, but see only impenetrable darkness. Your head is a void where memories once were, and an alien voice that knows more than it says.

RE:MEMBER is an atmospheric first-person horror game where normal vision is unavailable. The only way to navigate is echolocation. Every knock, step, or thrown object creates a visual wave that outlines the corridors and... those who inhabit them.

Your goal is to escape and reclaim your identity. But are you ready to discover the truth your past hides?

KEY FEATURES

1. SOUND VISUALIZATION

The game world is invisible. Use sound waves to "scan" your surroundings. Manage the noise level: quiet footsteps will provide little information but maintain stealth; A loud bang will illuminate the entire room, but will immediately attract attention.

2. SYMBIOSIS OR MADNESS?

You are not alone in your body. An entity has appeared within you. It grants you superhuman powers of perception and guides you, but who is it? The voice in your head can save your life or lead you into a trap. Trust it or resist it—it's up to you.

3. SMART ECOSYSTEM OF HORROR

Forget scripts. The enemies in the complex are blind but sensitive predators controlled by the adaptive AI system Stigma.

  • They listen: Monsters react to the slightest rustle.

  • They adapt: ​​If you hide too much, they will start checking for cover. If you run, they will ambush you.

  • They are unique: from the "Wanderers" patrolling the corridors to exotic monsters with their own unique logic.

PLOT

Waking up in a laboratory chamber, you realize you've lost your memory. All around you are the aftermath of a disaster: the bodies of staff and terrifying mutants. Your only connection to reality is a girl's voice on the radio and a terrifying whisper inside your own mind.

As you move deeper into the complex, you will discover fragments of your past. But with every step, with every use of your gift of echolocation, you will feel yourself changing.

RE:MEMBER is a story about what is more frightening: dying as a human or surviving by becoming something else.

data.short_description: A psychological horror where sound is your only sight. You awaken in the darkness of a laboratory, bereft of memory. Use echolocation to see the world, but beware: every sound betrays you to the nightmares that dwell in the darkness. Survive and remember who you are... or what you have become.

content_descriptors.notes: RE:MEMBER is a psychological horror game with violence and disturbing themes. The game features hostile creatures that attack and kill the player. The story explores loss of identity and involuntary body transformation. While visuals are stylized (point-cloud rendering), the narrative includes body horror and non-consensual experimentation themes. The atmosphere is consistently dark and oppressive throughout.
